ESH.name: Western Sahara
ESH.note: Western Sahara is disputed. Place names are scenario geography and do not assert sovereignty.

ATF.name: French Southern and Antarctic Lands
ATF.note: Research stations with rotating staff, not conventional cities. No permanent civilian city population is implied.

MDA.name: Moldova
MDA.note: Includes Tiraspol and Bender in the disputed Transnistrian region; the simplified scenario does not model current jurisdiction.

CYP.name: Cyprus
CYP.note: The island is divided in practice. The simplified country includes places across the divide and does not model current jurisdiction.

SOL.name: Somaliland
SOL.note: Somaliland is a disputed scenario entity. Place names and the simplified scenario do not assert recognition or current control.
SOL.flagNote: Somaliland has no distinct ISO 3166-1 code or standard regional-indicator flag emoji.

KOS.name: Kosovo
KOS.note: Kosovo is a disputed scenario entity; naming does not resolve recognition.
KOS.flagNote: XK is a commonly used user-assigned code, not an officially assigned ISO 3166-1 code.

KIR.name: Kiribati
KIR.note: Includes villages in South Tarawa and on Kiritimati; these are not separate large cities.

MHL.name: Marshall Islands
MHL.note: Delap-Uliga-Djarrit is the urban settlement of Majuro; Laura is a distinct settlement on the same atoll.

MCO.name: Monaco
MCO.note: Monaco is a city-state. Entries are real named quarters within the same city.

NRU.name: Nauru
NRU.note: Includes the named Yaren district alongside real settlements. These are not all incorporated cities.

SGP.name: Singapore
SGP.note: Singapore is a city-state. Entries are real URA planning areas within the same city.

TUV.name: Tuvalu
TUV.note: Includes island villages and Funafuti. These are not separate large cities.

VAT.name: Holy See (Vatican City)
VAT.note: Vatican City is the sole settlement; extra cities are not fabricated.
